summary: 12 v2 tasks reviewed for cross-task integration. Wave ordering and dependency graph are correct (no cycles). Critical issues remaining despite r1 fixes: (1) T6 still redeclares all v2 model types (InsightSkeleton, InsightSection, SectionType, DeepDiveTopic, SectionState, AnyCodable) inline in InsightSession.swift instead of consuming them from T4's MarkView/Models/InsightModels.swift — will cause duplicate-symbol compile errors; (2) T6 calls graphRAG.buildPhase1Prompts/buildPhase2SectionPrompts but T4 exports buildSkeleton/buildSectionPrompt — names do not match; (3) T6 declares cancel() as sync but T8's closeTab requires `await session.cancel()` — signature mismatch; (4) T8 didRequestInsightUp calls navigateTo with parentId.uuidString (String) but T6 expects UUID; (5) T7 and T8 both claim ownership of the 5 EditorView.Coordinator delegate stub bodies — wave-conflict on EditorView.swift between W4 and W5; (6) T8 references skeleton.sections.keys but sections is Array; (7) T8 forwarder/Coordinator method names include sessionId param but T7 protocol drops it. Several minor inconsistencies around archiveStagingDirectory sync/async, HTML rewriting ownership (T3 vs T8), and the iframe Retry path. T6 must be re-edited primarily; T8 needs synchronization with T6 cancel() async + UUID type + T7 protocol shape; T7/T8 need to pick one owner for EditorView.swift Coordinator stub bodies.
